description: This file defines the BuzzLikeOnCommentAPI class, which provides API endpoints for managing likes on comments within the 'orangehrmBuzzPlugin' plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to list, create (like), and delete (unlike) comment likes, integrating with the system's core services, entities, and validators.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnCommentAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for listing, liking, and unliking comments' likes within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of likes on a specified comment, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Adds a like to a specified comment, increasing the like count and creating a BuzzLikeOnComment record.

methods.name: setBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Helper method to set the comment ID, employee number, and timestamp on a BuzzLikeOnComment object.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a like from a specified comment, decreasing the like count and deleting the BuzzLikeOnComment record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for listing likes, primarily validating the comment ID and sorting parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for liking a comment, primarily validating the comment ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Defines validation rules for unliking a comment, primarily validating the comment ID.

methods.name: setBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Helper to set properties on BuzzLikeOnComment before saving.
